properties.title: Explainable Bayesian Artificial Intelligence for Precision Oncology: A Multimodal Framework for Personalized Cancer Prognosis
properties.verification_boundary: Checked in supplied title-page text and prior page-image review notes; external metadata and DOI resolution were not checked.

properties.source_path: Papers/089_2026_Explainable Bayesian Artificial Intelligence for Precision Oncology A Multimodal Framework for Personalized Cancer Prognosis.pdf
properties.pagination: Physical page 1 is the repository cover; physical pages 2–17 carry printed manuscript pages 1–16.
properties.license_boundary: The document license is not transferred to code, weights, or data.

properties.design: Author-reported synthetic multimodal prognosis comparison with calibration, ablations, risk stratification, and attribution analyses.
properties.lineage_boundary: The legacy candidate relationship with 094 remains unverified; its primary source was not supplied.

properties.name: Hierarchical Bayesian Multimodal Attention Fusion Network
properties.version_boundary: Configuration reported in the pinned manuscript; no checkpoint or code revision is identified.
properties.membership: Not a healthcare world model under the supplied identity criteria.
properties.membership_rationale: Per-patient feature encoding and fusion feed a Bernoulli-logistic prognostic model. No persistent health-world state is advanced through a learned transition.
properties.implementation_boundary: The manuscript reports execution and synthetic results. Raw-image/VAE/ViT execution and the allocation of HMC versus variational inference remain unresolved.
properties.time_semantics: The t(i) index is treatment-group membership, not clinical time. Posterior sampling and gradient iterations are not patient evolution.
properties.causal_boundary: Treatment-group random effects do not identify treatment effects; causal inference and dynamic treatment regimes are proposed future additions.

properties.reported_flow: Modality-specific encoding → Bayesian attention fusion → hierarchical prognostic probability → risk grouping and attribution.
properties.decision_boundary: Clinical applications are proposed, but no action optimizer, policy, operational execution, or measured decision impact is demonstrated.
properties.profile_boundary: BP_COMPONENT records reusable design relevance, not core-WM inclusion or completeness of a clinical system.

properties.responsibility: Reported probabilistic fusion of clinical, genomic, and imaging representations.
properties.boundary: Equations and reported ablation support the fusion responsibility; patient-dependent attention, compatible latent dimensions, and the executed encoder pipeline remain insufficiently specified.
properties.completeness: Limited M2 responsibility, not a complete validated M2 service.

properties.responsibility: Map fused features and cancer/treatment-group effects to prognostic probability.
properties.boundary: A static predictive-readout subrole of M7; no causal-effect subrole is established.
properties.missing_semantics: Outcome definition, prediction horizon, and a survival/censoring likelihood reconciling the reported survival analyses.

properties.actual_task: Prognostic discrimination, calibration, risk stratification, and attribution
properties.proposed_clinical_uses: Treatment selection, follow-up scheduling, and considering additional diagnostic testing.
properties.boundary: Specific malignancies, eligibility, clinical workflow, prediction horizon, and clinical execution authority are insufficiently specified.

properties.name: Unnamed synthetic multimodal oncology dataset
properties.version_boundary: Described in manuscript v1; no released dataset version is identified.
properties.generator: Described as a hierarchical survival process; distributions, effects, censoring, seeds, and executable generator are insufficiently specified.
properties.access: Simulated data available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request, according to the paper.
properties.clinical_dataset_boundary: TCGA, CPTAC, AACR Project GENIE, and UK Biobank are future validation suggestions, not demonstrated evaluation sources.

properties.count_boundary: Neither an actual-human participant count nor an established held-out denominator.

properties.ablation_boundary: Removal variants are reported; retraining, tuning parity, matching of evaluation partitions, and repeated-run design are not_reported.

properties.time_boundary: Figure 4 displays survival-outcome time in months, not a demonstrated state rollout or a defined prediction horizon for tabulated metrics.

assertions.rationale: Synthetic origin and preprocessing are described, but retained variable-level source, units, acquisition/availability metadata, transformation lineage, and versioned schema are not documented. Preprocessing descriptions alone do not establish retained provenance.

assertions.applicability_reason: The assessed computation uses static synthetic patient-feature records, not a recorded observation stream with a modeled temporal resolution. There is no native observation-clock retention target in this experiment.

assertions.rationale: No prognostic query cutoff or collection-versus-release semantics are specified. Static prediction does not eliminate possible availability leakage, and no actual violation is demonstrated.
The qualitative incomplete-genomics result does not specify measured/missing/invalid indicators, placeholder semantics, or model input masks.

assertions.applicability_reason: The assessed static-feature computation contains no carry-forward or asynchronous measurement-update operation for which per-variable elapsed measurement age must be maintained.
There is no input observation sequence or transition queried at unequal elapsed intervals in the documented prognostic mechanism. Treatment-group indexing is not clinical time.

assertions.rationale: No model of whether or why modalities are observed, conditional on patient/acquisition context, is specified. The synthetic missingness-generation mechanism and an explicit ignorability assumption are also unreported.

assertions.applicability_reason: The documented static synthetic-feature experiment does not resample a native observation stream onto a temporal grid. There is no defined grid/target distinction for a clock-witness audit.

assertions.rationale: Standardization, one-hot encoding, log transformation, and image normalization do not establish source-to-target terminology, unit, or measurement-definition mappings.

Splits, evaluated subset size, availability audits, and training-only fitting of preprocessing, encoders, and tuning are not reported. Synthetic data do not make leakage control inapplicable; no leakage event is established.
No local-site training/query, artifact exchange, or aggregation protocol is described. Future multicenter validation is not federation.

Modality-specific observation-to-feature mappings, genomic VAE compression, and ViT representations are specified. This establishes an encoder specification, not separately verified execution on raw modalities or a persistent world state.

No named reused checkpoint/version or adaptation procedure is supplied. ViT architecture and related-work citations do not establish foundation-model reuse; imaging foundation models are prospective additions.

No context-to-target representation-prediction loss is specified. Auxiliary encoder objectives are incomplete, so neither a VAE bottleneck nor the generic posterior objective establishes this feature or its explicit absence.
No anti-collapse constraint, mechanism, property, or collapse test is described. The incompletely specified representation objectives do not justify an absent-parent inapplicability inference.

Naming genomic VAE compression does not identify an executed decoder, observation target, likelihood, or reconstruction loss. The generic prognostic objective does not resolve auxiliary encoder losses.

Identified modalities interact through a weighted fusion operation, and an attention-fusion removal ablation is reported. This supports feature existence and reported evaluation, not a validated interface, patient-conditioned attention, or independently confirmed execution.

No availability/quality/recency conditioning or missing-modality fusion rule is specified. Qualitatively greater uncertainty with incomplete genomics establishes neither this mechanism nor a mandatory-all-modalities implementation.

The inspected incompatible mechanism encodes each patient, fuses features, and directly predicts a Bernoulli outcome. No state/history is carried through a subsequent health-world prediction/update. Group effects and posterior-fitting iterations are not evolving patient state; longitudinal trajectories are prospective.

assertions.applicability_reason: The static prognosis component maintains no evolving hidden health-world state over an observation history. Bayesian parameter and outcome uncertainty are not a filtering belief over such a state.
The documented static encoding-to-prognosis computation has no health-world propagation and sequential measurement-correction operations to separate.
The experiment does not maintain a current individual world state or a sequential-use protocol receiving arriving measurements. Posterior estimation during fitting is a different operation.

assertions.rationale: No fitting rule updates an individual's parameters or weights using new personal measurements. Group partial pooling and patient-specific features do not establish adaptation; an explicit fixed-parameter deployment configuration is also absent from the reporting.

No shared checkpoint/representation feeding two distinct typed tasks is established. Multiple metrics and risk-group summaries do not prove separate readout heads; an unexplained survival analysis cannot be repaired into a multi-task architecture.

Imaging/genomic omission ablations assess omitted information against the static prognostic target. This meets the assessment criterion narrowly; it establishes neither an evolving state nor successful decision/transition sufficiency. Table assignments, matched splits, retraining, and acceptance criteria remain unresolved.
Treatment history is a proposed clinical input category, but the synthetic clinical variables are not identified and no operational history encoding or evaluated history dependence is described.
No matched history/individual swap, withholding, population-prior, or analogous personalization control is reported. Removing a modality across a model variant is not such a control.

assertions.applicability_reason: The static predictor does not propagate or generate patient/anatomical/scene identities across transitions. Cross-transition identity preservation has no operation to constrain; patient indexing and data identity remain separate concerns.

assertions.rationale: Attention weights and SHAP rankings explain input contributions, not the meanings of latent coordinates or an inspectable physiological state. No corresponding state-semantic mapping is documented.

No history buffer, recurrence, ordered context, retrieval, or memory window is specified. Mentioned treatment history does not establish a memory mechanism or explicit exclusion of historical summaries.

The documented predictor consumes fused observations and grouping effects, without a separated settable intervention/command query. Treatment history/group is passive prognostic information; dynamic treatment-regime modeling is prospective. This is a scoped incompatible-mechanism inference, not absence inferred from silence.

assertions.applicability_reason: The assessed predictor has no operational action space whose roles and effect channels can be typed. Proposed downstream clinical decisions do not instantiate such an action space.
No intervention query or executable action is represented in this static prognosis computation, so dose, route, duration, units, and frame semantics have no action object to parameterize.
The implemented task lacks a time-indexed intervention input or regime-simulation operation. Treatment-group indexing and survival-outcome time are not action schedules.
The predictor does not construct or edit interventions, so there are no joint-action components, replacements, or inherited settings requiring bundle-update semantics.
The reported computation neither generates nor filters candidate actions. This narrow action-space dependency does not remove the relevance of output safeguards for proposed clinical use.
The latent variables encode patient features, not actions. There is no action-to-operation or latent-to-command mapping to ground.
No intervention alternatives or action-query distribution are evaluated. Treatment-group partial pooling is not a support/overlap assessment.

The evaluated task compares prognostic models/ablations, not successors under settable actions from a common initial patient context. Model-component removal is not an alternative patient intervention.

assertions.rationale: Downstream treatment/testing decisions are proposed, but no reversibility or residual-harm assessment is reported. Lack of direct actuation in the experiment does not establish reversibility of clinical consequences.

The inspected algorithm maps per-patient features to a prognostic probability, not a carried state/history to a subsequent state/observation. Future-outcome prognosis, group effects, and fitting iterations do not supply a health-world transition. Longitudinal trajectories are proposed future additions.

assertions.applicability_reason: No health-world transition operator is implemented in the assessed mechanism. Whether such an operator is learned, hybrid, estimated, or fixed has no applicable object; fitted encoders/regression do not change that.
There is no successor-state transition to condition on an intervention. Treatment-group effects enter a static prognostic readout, not an action-conditioned world transition.
No next-state process is defined. Random attention, random effects, and posterior prognostic uncertainty are not stochastic health-world transitions.

assertions.rationale: Cancer/treatment random effects provide explicit statistical grouping and partial pooling, but no operative physical, physiological, anatomical, conservation, monotonicity, object, or symbolic constraint is specified. Generic Bayesian priors and hierarchical regression are not promoted to the catalogue's domain-mechanistic/structural feature merely because they use equations. Specific biological priors remain unreported.

Neural features and Bayesian regression are combined, but no operational mechanistic component with fixed/fitted/learned quantities is identified. Statistical hierarchy is not a mechanistic–learned hybrid.

assertions.applicability_reason: The component has no state-transition backend or state/action/time transition contract. End-to-end prognostic baselines are not exchanged dynamics implementations.
The static fusion pipeline contains no evolving physical/spatial/temporal levels exchanging state or constraints. Multiple modalities and statistical grouping are not coupled multiscale dynamics.
The specified prognostic training problem traverses no sequence of predicted world states. Negative-log-posterior optimization steps are not modeled transitions.
Cancer/treatment-group hierarchy is statistical, not coordination of transitions at multiple durations or levels. The static model has no temporal transition resolution to abstract.

assertions.rationale: No observation-emission decoder or evaluated generation of clinical/genomic/imaging observations is sufficiently specified. A named VAE does not establish its executed decoder, and a prognostic task head is not automatically an observation decoder.

criteria_met: An explicit logistic readout yields a Bernoulli probability from fused features and grouping effects.
criteria_missing: Survival/censoring formulation reconciling the binary likelihood with survival analyses
assertions.rationale: A partially specified static probability readout is established, not a fully qualified survival, world-trajectory, or causal-effect head.

The inspected static mechanism and its evaluation assess endpoint prognosis, calibration, grouping, attribution, and ablations, not a declared predecessor-to-successor state prediction. Longitudinal trajectories are prospective. This is scoped absence of a world-successor evaluation, not denial that prognosis concerns future outcomes.

assertions.applicability_reason: No successive state-transition sequence exists in the assessed model to receive generated intermediate predictions. Survival curves and parameter sampling are not recursive rollout.
The evaluation has no successive predictive steps at which reference states could replace generated states. Observed patient features in a static predictor are not teacher forcing.
The model has no propagated individual state corrected between forecast episodes. Fitting a Bayesian posterior is not re-assimilation of arriving patient observations.

assertions.rationale: The horizon of the reported prognostic metrics is not defined. Figure 4's 0–60-month survival display, documented in earlier image reviews, is not an established model prediction extent or rollout horizon.

assertions.applicability_reason: No generated predictions drive successive transitions, so compounding error versus free-running depth is outside this static model's task.
The assessed configuration is not a temporal rollout/planning service. Its unresolved endpoint horizon is recorded separately; aggregate prognosis metrics cannot establish a supported rollout depth.
The output is static prognosis, not a joint distribution over future state trajectories. Posterior parameter/attention draws or probability intervals are not sampled world trajectories.
The documented component has no requested-horizon simulation/planning interface to reject, truncate, or escalate. This does not establish safe horizon use in a future deployment.

assertions.rationale: Risk-based treatment/follow-up guidance is proposed, but no executed consequence-to-action ranking, utility calculation, policy learning, or decision pathway is sufficiently documented. Risk stratification is not by itself demonstrated decision coupling.

assertions.applicability_reason: The scoped component has no world-transition/imagination interface or action-selection task. Parameter optimization is not an optimizer/policy using modeled action consequences.
No action plan is computed/executed by the static predictor, so post-prefix observation and replanning have no operational referent. Proposed follow-up guidance is not such a loop.
There is no learned world transition and model-coupled decision objective to separate. Changing prognostic losses/heads would not establish objective-independent dynamics.

The reported computation has no implemented planning score, candidate acceptance, or action-selection policy for uncertainty to alter. A proposed clinician use of uncertainty is not an evaluated planner.
No plans are optimized against a simulator, so there are no model-optimized actions whose exploitation can be tested. Prognostic ablations and calibration do not establish exploitation resistance.
The component constructs no action candidate set. Treatment groups and prognostic risk groups are not candidate regimens.
The statistical random-effect hierarchy is not a decision policy. No goals/options and subordinate actions with durations/termination are instantiated.
The task is static prognosis, without action–environment–observation interaction by a controller. Fitting iterations and survival plots are not a closed-loop control test.

assertions.rationale: The manuscript specifies Bayesian outcome/parameter uncertainty, reports posterior inference, and names posterior predictive intervals. This supports an author-reported implemented uncertainty mechanism, not posterior correctness, coverage, decomposition, or independently verified execution. HMC/VI roles remain unresolved.

Separate aleatoric/epistemic quantities, estimation procedures, and limitations are not specified. A Bernoulli likelihood, parameter posterior, and multiple random effects do not establish implemented decomposition.

criteria_met: Probability reliability is compared in a calibration display.
The experiment's synthetic origin is identified.
criteria_missing: Defined validation sample and fitting/tuning separation
Precisely defined event and prediction horizon
ECE binning/weighting and interval nominal-level/coverage specification
assertions.rationale: A calibration analysis exists, but target and validation-sample criteria are incomplete. The generated total is not an established calibration denominator. No acceptance pass is inferred.

assertions.applicability_reason: The component predicts static prognostic probabilities, not state trajectories or horizon-indexed rollout distributions. Endpoint ECE and survival-group displays are not joint-path calibration.

assertions.rationale: No named calibration acceptance criterion with uncertainty and intended-use scope is supplied. ECE 0.028 and the incomplete improvement statement cannot establish a tolerance pass.
No operational out-of-support statistic, threshold, response, or detector performance is specified. Qualitative missingness-related uncertainty is not a shift detector.
No nonconformity score, calibration split, set construction, or conformal coverage assumptions are reported. Bayesian intervals do not entail conformal calibration or its explicit exclusion.

The specified target is prognostic probability with grouping effects, not an intervention contrast. Causal inference and dynamic treatment regimes are explicitly prospective additions. These method/scope statements support absence of a causal estimand in the reported implemented model.

assertions.applicability_reason: The scoped current task targets prognosis, not intervention effects. Identification has no causal contrast to identify; a future therapeutic-effect interpretation would require a new applicable assessment.
No causal estimand/identification argument belongs to the current prognostic task. Gaussian random-effect and Bayesian prior assumptions are not estimand-linked identification assumptions.

There is no identified causal estimate in this scoped task whose confounding, positivity, or identification-assumption sensitivity can be assessed. Prognostic component ablations are a different analysis.
No action-effect prediction or potential-outcome contrast is evaluated. Synthetic outcome generation alone is not a known-potential-outcome validation target.
The scoped static predictor has no intervention-to-state process. Treatment grouping and statistical priors are not physical/pharmacological intervention semantics.
Current outputs are prognostic estimates, not asserted intervention-effect estimates. This is not a causal-assurance pass; treatment-guidance aspirations cannot be interpreted as identified effects.

assertions.rationale: No implemented prediction/recommendation blocking mechanism or fail behavior is specified. Uncertainty and risk grouping are not hard guards. Output safeguards remain relevant to proposed clinical uses.
No rejection trigger, withheld-output state, deferral decision, or fallback route is described. Increased uncertainty does not establish abstention or an always-predict implementation.
Clinician interpretation is proposed, but no operational case-routing trigger, responder, timing, or fallback is specified.
No online hazard signal, alarm logic, or linked protective response is reported. Retrospective result plots are not runtime assurance.
No safe-stop, output withdrawal, degraded mode, or fallback is specified/tested. Lack of physical actuation does not automatically make software fallback irrelevant.

No assets, adversary capabilities, or attack paths for inputs, representations, inference, or outputs are analyzed. Static prediction excludes some trajectory attacks but not data/prediction security concerns.
No defined adversarial or injected-fault protocol with measured safety outputs is reported. Component-removal ablations and qualitative incomplete-genomics observations do not establish red teaming.

No operational de-identification, authenticated access, encryption, federation, differential privacy, or minimization mechanism is specified. Synthetic origin and reasonable-request availability alone are not privacy controls.

No copying, membership, re-identification, or attribute-disclosure audit is reported. The incompletely specified synthetic generator does not establish a privacy guarantee or categorical inapplicability.

assertions.applicability_reason: The scoped computation ends in offline prognostic results, not external EHR writes, device commands, or administrative/therapeutic operations. No external action in this documented computation requires actuation permission; future integration is not assessed.

assertions.rationale: Uncertainty and attribution are proposed to aid clinician trust, but no reliance-calibration interface/protocol, override semantics, or human-factors outcome is reported. Explanation alone does not meet this mitigation criterion.

criteria_met: Proposed clinician users and treatment/follow-up/testing decisions
criteria_missing: Clinical workflow and precise decision point
assertions.rationale: A meaningful but incomplete intended-use description is present. Proposed applications remain separate from actual simulation evaluation.
No organized model/system card pins trained-artifact/data versions, assets, and supported-use limits. A versioned manuscript is not itself a model card.
No monitoring signals, thresholds, cadence, owner, response, or revalidation triggers are specified. Future validation is not post-release monitoring.
No versioned update approval, revalidation, change tracking, or rollback is reported. Model fitting is not operational change control.

No named regulatory/reporting framework for the model was identified in the supplied document. This is reporting silence, not proof that an applicable framework was considered/rejected. Creative Commons document licensing is separate.
No product/version/use/jurisdiction-specific applicability, compliance, or authorization evidence is supplied. Neither authorization nor denial/noncompliance is inferred.
No named approval, exemption, or consent determination is reported. Synthetic data do not themselves document an exemption; funding/conflict disclosures are different statements.

No operational LLM/agent role is identified. VAE/ViT encoders and Bayesian inference do not establish one, while incomplete auxiliary configurations do not explicitly exclude every possible dependency.

The described implemented configuration is a single feature-processing/fusion/prognosis pipeline of ordinary modules, not distinct decision-making agents with communication and coordination. This negative concerns that architecture, not undisclosed software dependencies.
No proposal/critique/feedback-revision loop is reported. Iterative inference/optimization is not agent reflection; an unresolved agent role is not used as an absent parent.
No operational agent external-tool/API calls with permissions are reported. Stan as an inference library is not evidence of an external agent action.
Clinical proposal/approval/execution responsibilities are not specified. Automated fitting or proposed clinician guidance does not establish operational autonomy.
No code repository or code-access statement is given. Reasonable-request availability concerns simulated data, not software.
No trained checkpoint, parameter/posterior-draw release, or weight-access conditions are identified. Attention summaries are results, not released weights.

criteria_met: A simulated-data access condition is explicitly stated.
criteria_missing: Dataset reuse permissions beyond reasonable-request access
assertions.rationale: Asset access/licensing is incomplete. The manuscript's CC BY 4.0 license is recorded separately and is not transferred to code, weights, or data; data access was not tested.
No independent pinned execution and replication outcome is reported. Author simulation replications and this automated review are not independent reproduction.

The documented experiment evaluates static endpoint prognosis and associated analyses, not a declared world-transition successor against a reference. The static architecture and prospective longitudinal addition support this scoped negative; prognosis metrics remain genuine reported results but are not E1 transition fidelity.

assertions.applicability_reason: No recursive or block-generated future-state/observation sequence is produced by this static predictor. Risk-group survival curves are not multi-step prediction sequences.

HBMAF-Net is evaluated as a prognostic predictor, not a generator of multimodal records/observations for distributional-realism assessment. Synthetic training/evaluation resources are not demonstrated generated products of this predictor.

assertions.rationale: The SHAP ranking is described as biologically consistent, but no defined biological, anatomical, clinical-consistency, or adverse-case constraint test is reported.

criteria_met: An explicit reliability-related ECE result and calibration display are reported.
Posterior predictive intervals are named as an evaluation method.
criteria_missing: Interval nominal levels and measured coverage
assertions.rationale: A calibration assessment is reported, but the complete held-out, regime-qualified uncertainty-evaluation criterion is not established. Binning, denominator, result uncertainty, and acceptance policy are also missing.

assertions.applicability_reason: The configuration has no operational action-query prediction task. Treatment grouping, modality ablations, and SHAP are not controlled action edits with matched context.
The current output is prognosis, without a causal/interventional contrast or counterfactual reference target. Synthetic factual outcomes alone do not instantiate such a benchmark.

assertions.rationale: No matched correct-individual versus swapped/withheld/population-prior control is reported. Patient-level prediction and global modality removal do not establish personalization evidence.

Decision guidance is proposed, but no action-selection, clinician-decision, policy-value, regret, or other decision-quality endpoint is reported. Predictive discrimination and survival-group separation are not decision-quality measurements.
No matched synthetic-versus-clinical task or outcome comparison quantifies agreement/bias. Real-cohort validation is prospective work, not sim-to-real evidence.

criteria_met: Imaging-omission and genomic-omission variants are reported.
A qualitative performance decline under genomic removal is reported.
criteria_missing: A protocol distinguishing inference-time missing modalities from separately trained reduced-input models
Defined evaluation partition and missingness conditions
assertions.rationale: This is a limited omitted-input assessment, not established runtime missing-modality resilience or external transfer. The separate qualitative uncertainty statement supplies no quantified missingness stress protocol. External/site/subgroup tests are not inferred.

assertions.applicability_reason: The scoped static synthetic-feature experiment has no native measurement stream converted to a grid or target dependent on clock-witness retention. Survival-outcome months do not create an observation-clock audit target.

assertions.rationale: No actual reader/user study, participants, task, sampling, or outcomes are reported. Attention, SHAP, and author contribution labels are not human evaluation.
No measured runtime, throughput, memory, compute, or sample efficiency with hardware/workload context is supplied. Scalable posterior-estimation wording is not a measurement.

The documented synthetic-prognosis experiment is incompatible with a comparative real-care/workflow study measuring utility and harms. Actual clinical validation is future work. Absence is scoped to a qualifying utility evaluation here, not proof that benefit is impossible or that a utility test failed.

assertions.applicability_reason: There is no predecessor-to-successor world operator to locate in latent versus observation space. Static VAE/ViT features and attention fusion are representation operations, not latent dynamics.
No world-state transition or reward/value/policy objective exists to carry a value-equivalence contract. A prognostic probability is not automatically a control value.

assertions.rationale: The executed raw-modality encoder pipeline is unresolved: methods describe raw-image preprocessing and VAE/ViT encoding, whereas simulation describes generated genomic/imaging features. Code/configuration connecting generated inputs, encoders, and evaluated predictions would resolve this. The separate encoder specification remains supported.

relation_assertions.rationale: Source cover metadata and supplied version/hash record identify the read version; the hash was not recomputed.
Reported execution, not independently confirmed artifact execution.
Fusion subresponsibility only, not complete M2 implementation.
Predictive-readout subrole only; no causal reasoning is inherited.

relation_assertions.value: F_i, the attention-weighted fused feature vector
relation_assertions.rationale: Operational mathematical handoff, not a complete tested interface contract.
Identifies actual research context while retaining clinical applications as proposals.
Synthetic source use is explicit; split roles remain unresolved.

criteria_met: Generated sample unit/count and connection to the experiment
relation_assertions.rationale: Does not invent a held-out cohort.
Static prognosis is not persistent-state evolution. No evaluated WM-inspired representation objective supports L0; no transition-successor result supports L1.
Author-reported synthetic technical feasibility only. R2 requires held-out actual human/clinical data and is not established.
Uncertainty/calibration reporting informs assurance design; it does not implement a safeguard or complete M9 module.

To evaluate the proposed Hierarchical Bayesian Multimodal Attention F usion Network (HBMAF-Net),
a comprehensive simulation study was conducted using synthetic m ultimodal oncology datasets that
mimic real-world cancer patient characteristics.
The generated dataset consisted of 10,000 patients with three modalities as Clinical variables ( pc =
50); Genomic features ( pg = 5, 000) and Imaging features ( pi = 1, 024).
Cancer outcomes were simulated according to a hierarchical survival p rocess with modality-speciﬁc
eﬀects and latent heterogeneity among cancer subtypes.

limitations: Automated model review, not independent human verification, independent replication, clinical validation, or authorization.

This synthesis read the complete supplied text and all 17 earlier automated page-image review notes. It did not receive page-image pixels directly. Earlier page calls documented text/image coverage of all physical pages; their chunk-local unavailable-page caveats do not imply missing pages in the combined packet.
Source path, physical page count, and hash are supplied metadata. No filesystem access, hash recomputation, DOI lookup, code execution, schema-validator execution, or graph rebuild was performed.

All 128 supplied operational feature definitions were considered. The 129 feature assertions include separate encoder specification and unresolved evaluated-implementation scopes; full coverage is not proof that unresolved features exist or are absent.

The 10,000 records are simulated patients, not actual participants or an established test denominator. Generator details, partitions, event/censoring counts, seeds, replication counts, and metric uncertainty are insufficiently specified.

Raw-modality VAE/ViT/CNN execution is not separately established by results on generated features. CNN-versus-ViT descriptions, concatenation-versus-weighted fusion, latent dimensions, and patient-dependent attention are unresolved.
The written Bernoulli-logistic model is called a survival model without adequate event, horizon, survival likelihood, or censoring definitions. Survival-outcome time is not world-transition time.

HMC in Stan, variational inference, and negative-log-posterior minimization are not reconciled into a reproducible inference procedure. Parameterization, priors, optimization settings, posterior samples, and convergence diagnostics are incomplete.

Tables 1–3 are malformed in text and, according to earlier image reviews, rendered source. Uncorroborated assignments remain tentative; no numerical repair, improvement calculation, or approximate plot-derived metric is promoted to a result.
AUC 0.931, C-index 0.917, and ECE 0.028 are clearly stated in prose. Their target horizons, evaluated denominators, uncertainty, and held-out status are not_reported.
Incomplete source numbers ending at AUC improvement '4.1' and ECE reduction 'more than 50' are preserved without added units or percentages.

The calibration figure's caption refers to competing models, but earlier image review found only HBMAF-Net and an ideal reference. ECE does not establish posterior interval coverage or an acceptance tolerance.

Earlier visual reviews describe unexplained density normalization and smooth ROC/Kaplan–Meier-labeled curves without uncertainty or risk tables. Their construction is unresolved; no fabrication allegation is made.
Attention/SHAP attribution is not interpretable latent-state semantics, causal contribution, explanation-fidelity validation, clinician trust, or demonstrated actionability.
Ablations establish a limited omitted-information assessment, not sufficient world state, personalized-history value, fixed-model missing-modality robustness, or external transfer.
Statistical grouping and generic Bayesian priors are retained as described, not promoted to an implemented biological mechanism or mechanistic intervention semantics.
Only R1 synthetic feasibility is supported. R2 needs held-out actual human/clinical data. No higher readiness, human study, prospective benefit, authorization, or monitoring evidence is inherited.
Code/weights, asset-specific licensing, and reasonable-request data access were not independently checked. Manuscript CC BY licensing is not a model/code/data license.
Potential overlap with 094 remains an unverified legacy candidate; no independent-study or duplicate certification is made.
References were read but cited works were not retrieved. Their datasets, capabilities, and clinical validation are not attributed to this model.
All raw legacy cells are preserved unchanged; corrections and synthesis suggestions remain separate. No source, workbook, canonical annotation, or graph file was modified.
